% PRISMA 2020 flow diagram (TikZ), two-column grid.
% Numbers come from prisma_numbers.tex (generated by tools/review/prisma_counts.py).
% Needs: \usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning,fit,calc} and prisma_colors.tex
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  font=\sffamily\scriptsize,
  every node/.style={inner sep=3.2pt},
  box/.style={draw=prismaline, line width=0.5pt, rounded corners=1.5pt, fill=white, align=left, text width=#1},
  src/.style={box=#1, fill=prismasrc},
  exc/.style={box=#1, fill=prismaexc},
  inc/.style={box=#1, fill=prismainc, line width=0.9pt},
  arr/.style={-{Stealth[length=1.8mm]}, line width=0.6pt, draw=prismaline},
  phase/.style={text=white, font=\sffamily\bfseries\scriptsize, rotate=90, anchor=center},
]
\newcommand\n[1]{\textit{n}\,=\,#1}
\def\LW{5.6cm}  % left column text width
\def\RW{9.0cm}  % right column text width

% ---------------- sources (identification, row 0) ----------------
\node[src=4.75cm, anchor=north west] (s1) at (0,0) {\textbf{Author-curated corpus}\\[1pt]
  DBLP 2025--2026 venues: \n{\PRcorpusDBLP}\\ arXiv sweep, July 2026: \n{\PRcorpusArxiv}};
\node[src=4.75cm, anchor=north west] (s2) at ([xshift=2.6mm]s1.north east) {\textbf{ACL Anthology} (full dump)\\[1pt]
  title match, 1999--2026\\ \n{\PRacl}};
\node[src=4.75cm, anchor=north west] (s3) at ([xshift=2.6mm]s2.north east) {\textbf{OpenAlex} (17 query phrases)\\[1pt]
  title + abstract, 1999--2026\\ \n{\PRopenalex}};

% ---------------- right column (drives the vertical layout) ----------------
\node[exc=\RW, anchor=north east] (r1) at ([yshift=-7mm]s3.south east) {\textbf{Records removed before screening}\\[1pt]
  duplicate records: \n{\PRduplicates}\qquad outside 1999--2026 or non-English: \n{\PRwindow}};
\node[exc=\RW, below=4mm of r1] (r2) {\textbf{Records excluded:} \n{\PRscreenExcluded}\\[1pt]
  EC1 retrieval / RAG / QA system without topic structure: \PRecA\\
  EC2 supervised extraction or classification only: \PRecB\\
  EC3 non-text modality only: \PRecC\qquad EC5 not a research article: \PRecE\\
  EC4 ``topic'' used in another sense (stance, dialogue, diffusion, \ldots): \PRecD};
\node[exc=\RW, below=4mm of r2] (r3) {\textbf{Reports not retrieved:} \n{\PRnotRetrieved}\\[1pt]
  no open-access copy found (publisher paywall, no preprint)};
\node[exc=\RW, below=4mm of r3] (r4) {\textbf{Full texts excluded:} \n{\PRftExcluded}\\[1pt]
  FT1 no topic-modelling contribution or use: \PRftA\\
  FT2 superseded by an extended version of the same work: \PRftB\\
  FT3 no empirical or formal evaluation: \PRftC};
\node[box=\RW, below=4mm of r4, fill=prismainc!45] (r5) {\textbf{Included studies by taxonomy category}\\[1pt]
  algebraic \& probabilistic: \PRcA \quad short-text: \PRcB \quad neural (VAE / OT / contrastive / graph): \PRcC\\
  PLM-embedding \& clustering: \PRcD \quad LLM-based: \PRcE \quad evaluation methodology: \PRcG\\
  dynamic / hierarchical / cross-lingual / multimodal: \PRcF\\
  applications: \PRcH \quad surveys: \PRcI};

% ---------------- left column (aligned to the right column rows) ----------------
\coordinate (L) at (s1.west);
\node[box=\LW, anchor=west] (l1) at (L |- r1) {\textbf{Records identified}\\ \n{\PRidentified}};
\node[box=\LW, anchor=west] (l2) at (L |- r2) {\textbf{Records screened} (title + abstract)\\ \n{\PRscreened}};
\node[box=\LW, anchor=west] (l3) at (L |- r3) {\textbf{Reports sought for retrieval}\\ \n{\PRsought}};
\node[box=\LW, anchor=west] (l4) at (L |- r4) {\textbf{Full texts assessed for eligibility}\\ \n{\PRassessed}};
\node[inc=\LW, anchor=west] (l5) at (L |- r5) {\textbf{Studies included in the review}\\ \n{\PRincluded}};

% ---------------- arrows ----------------
\foreach \s in {s1,s2,s3} \draw[arr] (\s.south) -- ++(0,-3.5mm) -| (l1.north);
\foreach \a/\b in {l1/l2,l2/l3,l3/l4,l4/l5} \draw[arr] (\a) -- (\b);
\foreach \a/\b in {l1/r1,l2/r2,l3/r3,l4/r4,l5/r5} \draw[arr] (\a.east) -- (\a.east -| \b.west);

% ---------------- phase bands ----------------
\foreach \top/\bot/\lab/\col in {s1/l1/Identification/prismaphase, r2/r4/Screening/prismaphase,
                                 r5/r5/Included/prismaincline} {
  \coordinate (pt) at ([xshift=-8mm]L |- \top.north);
  \coordinate (pb) at ([xshift=-3.5mm]L |- \bot.south);
  \fill[\col, rounded corners=1pt] (pt) rectangle (pb);
  \node[phase] at ($(pt)!0.5!(pb)$) {\lab};
}
\end{tikzpicture}
